findings.text: GRED top level control uses netlink selectors for parameter exchange. Members include TCA_GRED_PARMS for parameters and TCA_GRED_STAB for tables and TCA_GRED_DPS for precedence data and TCA_GRED_LIMIT for bounds and TCA_GRED_VQ_LIST for nested queue entries plus TCA_GRED_MAX_P for extra parameters. The set starts at an unspecified zero with public maximum one below an internal sentinel.

GRED queue telemetry uses nested attributes. A wrapper carries TCA_GRED_VQ_ENTRY for one nested object. Leaf members carry TCA_GRED_VQ_DP for identity and TCA_GRED_VQ_STAT_BYTES for bytes and TCA_GRED_VQ_STAT_PACKETS for packets and TCA_GRED_VQ_STAT_BACKLOG for backlog plus TCA_GRED_VQ_STAT_PROB_DROP for probabilistic drops and TCA_GRED_VQ_STAT_PROB_MARK for probabilistic marks and TCA_GRED_VQ_STAT_FORCED_DROP for forced drops and TCA_GRED_VQ_STAT_FORCED_MARK for forced marks and TCA_GRED_VQ_STAT_PDROP for limit drops and TCA_GRED_VQ_STAT_OTHER for other drops with TCA_GRED_VQ_FLAGS for flags and TCA_GRED_VQ_PAD for alignment. Both levels start at zero with maxima one below sentinels.

GRED queue option describes one virtual queue. It stores limit for hard byte cap and qth_min with qth_max for average thresholds and DP for precedence number and backlog with qave for occupancy measures and forced with early and other plus pdrop for drop outcomes and Wlog with Plog and Scell_log for logarithmic tuning and prio for priority and packets with bytesin for lifetime totals. Thresholds and counters use fixed width unsigned integers while tuning uses single bytes.

GRED global setup stores DPs for active precedence count and def_DP for default precedence and grio for priority and flags for behaviour with pad1 preserving alignment. Counts use fixed width unsigned integers while priority and flags use single bytes.
Default precedence array bound MAX_DPs equals 16.

CHOKE control uses a compact netlink set with TCA_CHOKE_PARMS for parameters and TCA_CHOKE_STAB for tables plus TCA_CHOKE_MAX_P for extra parameters. The set starts at an unspecified zero with public maximum one below an internal sentinel.

CHOKE parameters store limit for hard packet cap and qth_min with qth_max for average thresholds and Wlog with Plog and Scell_log for logarithmic tuning and flags for RED style options. Extended statistics store early for early drops and pdrop for limit drops and other for internal drops and marked for marked packets and matched for flow match drops. All fields use fixed width unsigned storage.
HTB hierarchy bounds are TC_HTB_NUMPRIO equal to 8 for priorities and TC_HTB_MAXDEPTH equal to 8 for levels with TC_HTB_PROTOVER equal to 3 for wire version shared with user tools.

HTB control distinguishes class parameters and global setup plus rate tables and queue depth with wide rate extensions and offload. Members include TCA_HTB_PARMS for class data and TCA_HTB_INIT for global data and TCA_HTB_CTAB with TCA_HTB_RTAB for tables and TCA_HTB_DIRECT_QLEN for direct depth and TCA_HTB_RATE64 with TCA_HTB_CEIL64 for wide rates and TCA_HTB_PAD for alignment and TCA_HTB_OFFLOAD for hardware. The set starts at zero with maximum one below sentinel.

HTB class option embeds rate with ceil shaping subrecords and stores buffer with cbuffer for bursts and quantum for share and level for depth reported to user and prio for priority. Global setup stores version for compatibility and rate2quantum for conversion and defcls for default class and debug for flags and direct_pkts for unshaped count. Extended statistics store lends with borrows for sharing events and giants for legacy oversize and tokens with ctokens for balances where balances use signed integers and others use unsigned.

HFSC control carries three curve selectors with TCA_HFSC_RSC for real time service and TCA_HFSC_FSC for fair service plus TCA_HFSC_USC for upper bound. The set starts at zero with maximum one below sentinel.

HFSC option stores defcls for default class in narrow unsigned form. Service curve stores m1 for first slope in bits per second and d for first projection in microseconds and m2 for second slope. Statistics store work for total service and rtwork for real time service in wide unsigned form with period for current period and level for hierarchy depth.

Emulator control covers loss and timing plus rate and slot behaviour. Members include TCA_NETEM_CORR for correlation and TCA_NETEM_DELAY_DIST for delay tables and TCA_NETEM_REORDER for reorder and TCA_NETEM_CORRUPT for corruption and TCA_NETEM_LOSS for loss and TCA_NETEM_RATE for rate and TCA_NETEM_ECN for marking plus TCA_NETEM_RATE64 for wide rate and TCA_NETEM_LATENCY64 with TCA_NETEM_JITTER64 for wide timing and TCA_NETEM_SLOT with TCA_NETEM_SLOT_DIST for slots and TCA_NETEM_PRNG_SEED for seeding plus TCA_NETEM_PAD for alignment. The set starts at zero with maximum one below sentinel.

Emulator base option stores latency for added microseconds and limit for packet fifo cap and loss for loss likelihood and gap for reorder spacing and duplicate for duplication likelihood and jitter for variation. Correlation stores delay_corr with loss_corr and dup_corr for dependence across packets. Reorder stores probability with correlation for reorder likelihood and corrupt stores probability with correlation for error likelihood. Likelihoods use fixed point where zero is none and all bits set is full.

Emulator rate shaping stores rate for bytes per second and packet_overhead with cell_overhead for signed adjustments and cell_size for framing unit. Slot control stores min_delay with max_delay for nanosecond bounds and max_packets with max_bytes for slot capacity in signed form and dist_delay with dist_jitter for distribution offsets in nanosecond signed wide form.

Loss model selectors are NETEM_LOSS_GI for intuitive four state handling and NETEM_LOSS_GE for Gilbert Elliot handling starting at zero with NETEM_LOSS_MAX one below sentinel. Distribution scaling uses NETEM_DIST_SCALE equal to 8192 with NETEM_DIST_MAX equal to 16384 bounding table size.

Intuitive loss parameters store p13 with p31 and p32 plus p14 with p23 for transition likelihoods. Gilbert Elliot parameters store p with r and h plus k1 for model likelihoods. Extended statistics store delayed for deferred packets and dropped for model drops and corrupted for errored packets and duplicated for extra copies and reordered for misordered packets and ecn_marked for marked but forwarded packets and allocation_errors for resource failures in wide unsigned form.
Deficit round robin control offers TCA_DRR_QUANTUM for quantum starting at zero with maximum one below sentinel.
Deficit round robin statistics store deficit for current credit in fixed width unsigned form.

Multiqueue priority bounds use TC_QOPT_BITMASK equal to 15 for priority map and TC_QOPT_MAX_QUEUE equal to 16 for queue arrays. Offload offers TC_MQPRIO_HW_OFFLOAD_NONE for none and TC_MQPRIO_HW_OFFLOAD_TCS for class offload. Mode offers TC_MQPRIO_MODE_DCB for bridging and TC_MQPRIO_MODE_CHANNEL for channel. Shaper offers TC_MQPRIO_SHAPER_DCB for bridging and TC_MQPRIO_SHAPER_BW_RATE for bandwidth. Preemption uses TC_FP_EXPRESS equal to 1 and TC_FP_PREEMPTIBLE equal to 2. Presence flags use TC_MQPRIO_F_MODE equal to 0x1 and TC_MQPRIO_F_SHAPER equal to 0x2 and TC_MQPRIO_F_MIN_RATE equal to 0x4 and TC_MQPRIO_F_MAX_RATE equal to 0x8.

Multiqueue priority option stores num_tc for class count and prio_tc_map for priority mapping sized by bitmask plus one and hw for offload mode and count with offset for per queue sizes and bases sized by maximum queue constant. Mapping and hardware use single bytes while arrays use narrow unsigned integers.

Multiqueue priority entries distinguish per class data and top controls. Entry members include TCA_MQPRIO_TC_ENTRY_INDEX for position and TCA_MQPRIO_TC_ENTRY_FP for preemption with maximum one below count. Top members include TCA_MQPRIO_MODE for mode and TCA_MQPRIO_SHAPER for shaper and TCA_MQPRIO_MIN_RATE64 with TCA_MQPRIO_MAX_RATE64 for wide rates and TCA_MQPRIO_TC_ENTRY for nested entries starting at zero with maximum one below sentinel.
Stochastic fair blue control offers TCA_SFB_PARMS for parameters starting at zero with maximum one below sentinel.

Stochastic fair blue parameters store rehash_interval for hash rotation in milliseconds and warmup_time for double buffer warmup with max for minimum length cap and bin_size for per bin cap and increment with decrement for probability steps and limit for queue cap and penalty_rate with penalty_burst for inelastic policing. Extended statistics store earlydrop with penaltydrop and bucketdrop plus queuedrop and childdrop for drop classes and marked for marks and maxqlen for peak length with maxprob and avgprob for probability extremes. All use fixed width unsigned integers.
Stochastic marking ceiling SFB_MAX_PROB equals 0xFFFF.
Quick fair queueing control offers TCA_QFQ_WEIGHT for weight and TCA_QFQ_LMAX for maximum size starting at zero with maximum one below sentinel.
Quick fair queueing statistics store weight with lmax for configured weight and size bounds in fixed width unsigned form.

Controlled delay control offers TCA_CODEL_TARGET for delay goal and TCA_CODEL_LIMIT for packet cap and TCA_CODEL_INTERVAL for window and TCA_CODEL_ECN for marking enable plus TCA_CODEL_CE_THRESHOLD for threshold marking starting at zero with maximum one below sentinel.

Controlled delay statistics store maxpacket for largest size and count with lastcount for drop sequencing and ldelay for recent delay and drop_next for next drop time in signed form and drop_overlimit for cap events and ecn_mark for marks instead of drops and dropping for state plus ce_mark for threshold marks.
Fair queue controlled delay quantum ceiling FQ_CODEL_QUANTUM_MAX equals one shifted left by twenty.

Fair queue controlled delay control covers delay and capacity plus flows and memory. Members include TCA_FQ_CODEL_TARGET for goal and TCA_FQ_CODEL_LIMIT for cap and TCA_FQ_CODEL_INTERVAL for window and TCA_FQ_CODEL_ECN for marking and TCA_FQ_CODEL_FLOWS for table size and TCA_FQ_CODEL_QUANTUM for share and TCA_FQ_CODEL_CE_THRESHOLD for threshold plus TCA_FQ_CODEL_DROP_BATCH_SIZE for batch and TCA_FQ_CODEL_MEMORY_LIMIT for bytes with TCA_FQ_CODEL_CE_THRESHOLD_SELECTOR and TCA_FQ_CODEL_CE_THRESHOLD_MASK for threshold selection starting at zero with maximum one below sentinel. Type values use TCA_FQ_CODEL_XSTATS_QDISC for queue view and TCA_FQ_CODEL_XSTATS_CLASS for class view.

Fair queue controlled delay queue view stores maxpacket for largest size and drop_overlimit with drop_overmemory for cap events and ecn_mark with ce_mark for marks and new_flow_count for creations and new_flows_len with old_flows_len for list sizes and memory_usage for bytes. Class view stores deficit for signed credit and ldelay for recent delay and count with lastcount for sequencing and dropping for state and drop_next for next drop time in signed form. Outer record stores type discriminator with a union holding either queue or class view.

Fair queue control early members include TCA_FQ_PLIMIT for total packet cap and TCA_FQ_FLOW_PLIMIT for per flow cap and TCA_FQ_QUANTUM for share and TCA_FQ_INITIAL_QUANTUM for new flow share and TCA_FQ_RATE_ENABLE for pacing enable and TCA_FQ_FLOW_MAX_RATE for per flow ceiling and TCA_FQ_BUCKETS_LOG for table sizing and TCA_FQ_FLOW_REFILL_DELAY for credit delay and TCA_FQ_ORPHAN_MASK for orphan hashing.

Fair queue control later members include TCA_FQ_LOW_RATE_THRESHOLD for small rate delay and TCA_FQ_CE_THRESHOLD for marking threshold and TCA_FQ_TIMER_SLACK for timer tolerance and TCA_FQ_HORIZON for time horizon and TCA_FQ_HORIZON_DROP for beyond horizon policy and TCA_FQ_PRIOMAP for priority mapping and TCA_FQ_WEIGHTS for band weights plus TCA_FQ_OFFLOAD_HORIZON for immediate dequeue horizon with TCA_FQ_FLOW_DEFAULT_RATE retained as obsolete. The full set starts at zero with maximum one below sentinel.
Fair queue banding uses FQ_BANDS equal to 3 with FQ_MIN_WEIGHT equal to 16384 as minimum band weight.

Fair queue statistics store gc_flows for reclaimed flows and highprio_packets with tcp_retrans retained as obsolete plus throttled for paced events and flows_plimit for cap events and pkts_too_long for oversize and allocation_errors for failures and time_next_delayed_flow for next paced flow in signed wide form with flows and inactive_flows plus throttled_flows for occupancy and unthrottle_latency_ns for wake delay and ce_mark for threshold marks and horizon_drops with horizon_caps for horizon handling and fastpath_packets for fast path plus band_drops with band_pkt_count per band arrays and pad for alignment.

Heavy hitter filter control offers TCA_HHF_BACKLOG_LIMIT for backlog cap and TCA_HHF_QUANTUM for share and TCA_HHF_HH_FLOWS_LIMIT for hitter cap and TCA_HHF_RESET_TIMEOUT for reset period and TCA_HHF_ADMIT_BYTES for admission and TCA_HHF_EVICT_TIMEOUT for eviction plus TCA_HHF_NON_HH_WEIGHT for non hitter weight starting at zero with maximum one below sentinel.

Heavy hitter statistics store drop_overlimit for queue cap events and hh_overlimit for hitter cap events and hh_tot_count for total hitters observed plus hh_cur_count for current hitters in fixed width unsigned form.

Proportional integral enhanced control offers TCA_PIE_TARGET for delay goal and TCA_PIE_LIMIT for cap and TCA_PIE_TUPDATE for update period and TCA_PIE_ALPHA with TCA_PIE_BETA for control gains and TCA_PIE_ECN for marking and TCA_PIE_BYTEMODE for byte accounting plus TCA_PIE_DQ_RATE_ESTIMATOR for rate estimation starting at zero with maximum one below sentinel.

Proportional integral statistics store prob for current likelihood in wide form and delay for current milliseconds and avg_dq_rate for dequeue estimate plus dq_rate_estimating for estimator state and packets_in for arrivals and dropped for control drops and overlimit for cap drops and maxq for peak size plus ecn_mark for marks.

Fair queue proportional integral control offers TCA_FQ_PIE_LIMIT for cap and TCA_FQ_PIE_FLOWS for table size and TCA_FQ_PIE_TARGET for goal and TCA_FQ_PIE_TUPDATE for period and TCA_FQ_PIE_ALPHA with TCA_FQ_PIE_BETA for gains and TCA_FQ_PIE_QUANTUM for share and TCA_FQ_PIE_MEMORY_LIMIT for bytes and TCA_FQ_PIE_ECN_PROB for mark likelihood and TCA_FQ_PIE_ECN for marking plus TCA_FQ_PIE_BYTEMODE for byte mode and TCA_FQ_PIE_DQ_RATE_ESTIMATOR for estimation starting at zero with maximum one below sentinel.

Fair queue proportional integral statistics store packets_in for arrivals and dropped for control drops and overlimit for space drops and overmemory for memory drops and ecn_mark for marks and new_flow_count for creations with new_flows_len and old_flows_len for list sizes plus memory_usage for bytes.

Credit based shaper option stores offload for hardware handling with pad preservation and hicredit with locredit for credit bounds and idleslope with sendslope for rate slopes. Slopes and credits use signed integers while leading bytes use unsigned.
Credit based shaper control offers TCA_CBS_PARMS for parameters starting at zero with maximum one below sentinel.

Earliest transmit first option stores delta for launch offset and clockid for clock choice and flags for behaviour. Behaviour bits use TC_ETF_DEADLINE_MODE_ON for deadline handling and TC_ETF_OFFLOAD_ON for offload plus TC_ETF_SKIP_SOCK_CHECK for skipping socket checks corresponding to low order single bit masks.
Earliest transmit first control offers TCA_ETF_PARMS for parameters starting at zero with maximum one below sentinel.

CAKE control early members include TCA_CAKE_PAD for alignment and TCA_CAKE_BASE_RATE64 for shaper rate and TCA_CAKE_DIFFSERV_MODE for class handling and TCA_CAKE_ATM for framing and TCA_CAKE_FLOW_MODE for flow keys and TCA_CAKE_OVERHEAD for framing adjustment and TCA_CAKE_RTT for round trip estimate and TCA_CAKE_TARGET for delay goal plus TCA_CAKE_AUTORATE for automatic shaping.

CAKE control later members include TCA_CAKE_MEMORY for bounds and TCA_CAKE_NAT for address handling and TCA_CAKE_RAW for raw mode and TCA_CAKE_WASH for header clearing and TCA_CAKE_MPU for minimum unit and TCA_CAKE_INGRESS for ingress mode and TCA_CAKE_ACK_FILTER for acknowledgement handling and TCA_CAKE_SPLIT_GSO for segmentation plus TCA_CAKE_FWMARK for mark use. The set starts at zero with maximum one below sentinel.

CAKE statistics distinguish capacity and memory plus length extremes and queue state with cobalt timing. Members include TCA_CAKE_STATS_PAD for alignment and TCA_CAKE_STATS_CAPACITY_ESTIMATE64 for rate estimate and TCA_CAKE_STATS_MEMORY_LIMIT with TCA_CAKE_STATS_MEMORY_USED for memory plus TCA_CAKE_STATS_AVG_NETOFF for offset and TCA_CAKE_STATS_MIN_NETLEN with TCA_CAKE_STATS_MAX_NETLEN for network sizes and TCA_CAKE_STATS_MIN_ADJLEN with TCA_CAKE_STATS_MAX_ADJLEN for adjusted sizes and TCA_CAKE_STATS_TIN_STATS for nested tins and TCA_CAKE_STATS_DEFICIT for credit and TCA_CAKE_STATS_COBALT_COUNT for cobalt state and TCA_CAKE_STATS_DROPPING for state and TCA_CAKE_STATS_DROP_NEXT_US for next drop and TCA_CAKE_STATS_P_DROP for likelihood and TCA_CAKE_STATS_BLUE_TIMER_US for timer plus TCA_CAKE_STATS_ACTIVE_QUEUES for occupancy. The set starts at an invalid zero with maximum one below sentinel.

CAKE tin statistics early members include TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_PAD for alignment and TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_SENT_PACKETS with TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_SENT_BYTES64 for sent totals and TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_DROPPED_PACKETS with TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_DROPPED_BYTES64 for dropped totals and TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_ACKS_DROPPED_PACKETS with TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_ACKS_DROPPED_BYTES64 for filtered acknowledgements and TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_ECN_MARKED_PACKETS with TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_ECN_MARKED_BYTES64 for marks plus TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_BACKLOG_PACKETS with TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_BACKLOG_BYTES for queued amounts.

CAKE tin statistics later members include TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_THRESHOLD_RATE64 for rate and TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_TARGET_US with TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_INTERVAL_US for timing and TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_WAY_INDIRECT_HITS with TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_WAY_MISSES and TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_WAY_COLLISIONS for hash behaviour and TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_PEAK_DELAY_US with TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_AVG_DELAY_US and TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_BASE_DELAY_US for delay plus TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_SPARSE_FLOWS with TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_BULK_FLOWS and TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_UNRESPONSIVE_FLOWS for flow classes and TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_MAX_SKBLEN for largest buffer plus TCA_CAKE_TIN_STATS_FLOW_QUANTUM for share. The set starts at invalid zero with maximum one below sentinel and TC_CAKE_MAX_TINS equals 8 bounding tin count.

CAKE flow key modes start at CAKE_FLOW_NONE equal to zero with CAKE_FLOW_SRC_IP for source and CAKE_FLOW_DST_IP for destination and CAKE_FLOW_HOSTS combining both addresses and CAKE_FLOW_FLOWS for five tuple plus CAKE_FLOW_DUAL_SRC combining source with flows and CAKE_FLOW_DUAL_DST combining destination with flows and CAKE_FLOW_TRIPLE combining hosts with flows ending at CAKE_FLOW_MAX as bound.

CAKE class handling offers CAKE_DIFFSERV_DIFFSERV3 at zero with CAKE_DIFFSERV_DIFFSERV4 and CAKE_DIFFSERV_DIFFSERV8 plus CAKE_DIFFSERV_BESTEFFORT and CAKE_DIFFSERV_PRECEDENCE ending at CAKE_DIFFSERV_MAX. Acknowledgement handling offers CAKE_ACK_NONE at zero with CAKE_ACK_FILTER and CAKE_ACK_AGGRESSIVE ending at CAKE_ACK_MAX. Framing offers CAKE_ATM_NONE at zero with CAKE_ATM_ATM and CAKE_ATM_PTM ending at CAKE_ATM_MAX.

Time aware shaper gate commands use TC_TAPRIO_CMD_SET_GATES for plain set and TC_TAPRIO_CMD_SET_AND_HOLD for hold plus TC_TAPRIO_CMD_SET_AND_RELEASE for release corresponding to values zero with one and two. Entry attributes include TCA_TAPRIO_SCHED_ENTRY_INDEX for position and TCA_TAPRIO_SCHED_ENTRY_CMD for command and TCA_TAPRIO_SCHED_ENTRY_GATE_MASK for gates plus TCA_TAPRIO_SCHED_ENTRY_INTERVAL for duration starting at zero with maximum one below sentinel.
Time aware shaper schedule list carries TCA_TAPRIO_SCHED_ENTRY for nested entries starting at zero with maximum one below sentinel.
Time aware shaper behaviour flags use TCA_TAPRIO_ATTR_FLAG_TXTIME_ASSIST for transmit time assistance at bit zero and TCA_TAPRIO_ATTR_FLAG_FULL_OFFLOAD for full offload at bit one.

Time aware shaper class entries include TCA_TAPRIO_TC_ENTRY_INDEX for position and TCA_TAPRIO_TC_ENTRY_MAX_SDU for size cap plus TCA_TAPRIO_TC_ENTRY_FP for preemption with maximum one below count. Offload statistics include TCA_TAPRIO_OFFLOAD_STATS_PAD for alignment and TCA_TAPRIO_OFFLOAD_STATS_WINDOW_DROPS for window drops plus TCA_TAPRIO_OFFLOAD_STATS_TX_OVERRUNS for overruns with maximum one below count.

Time aware shaper top control includes TCA_TAPRIO_ATTR_PRIOMAP for priority mapping reusing multiqueue priority option layout and TCA_TAPRIO_ATTR_SCHED_ENTRY_LIST for entry lists and TCA_TAPRIO_ATTR_SCHED_BASE_TIME for base time and TCA_TAPRIO_ATTR_SCHED_SINGLE_ENTRY for singleton plus TCA_TAPRIO_ATTR_SCHED_CLOCKID for clock and TCA_TAPRIO_PAD with TCA_TAPRIO_ATTR_PAD for alignment and TCA_TAPRIO_ATTR_ADMIN_SCHED for dumped admin state and TCA_TAPRIO_ATTR_SCHED_CYCLE_TIME with TCA_TAPRIO_ATTR_SCHED_CYCLE_TIME_EXTENSION for cycle plus TCA_TAPRIO_ATTR_FLAGS for behaviour and TCA_TAPRIO_ATTR_TXTIME_DELAY for delay and TCA_TAPRIO_ATTR_TC_ENTRY for nested class entries starting at zero with maximum one below sentinel.
Enhanced transmission selection band bound TCQ_ETS_MAX_BANDS equals 16.

Enhanced transmission selection control offers TCA_ETS_NBANDS for band count and TCA_ETS_NSTRICT for strict count and TCA_ETS_QUANTA for nested quanta with TCA_ETS_QUANTA_BAND for per band quantum plus TCA_ETS_PRIOMAP for nested mapping with TCA_ETS_PRIOMAP_BAND for per band priority starting at zero with maximum one below sentinel.

Public maxima consistently equal internal sentinel minus one with zero reserved for unspecified or invalid. This pattern holds for GRED and CHOKE plus HTB and HFSC and emulator and round robin families and for multiqueue and blue and fair queueing plus delay and heavy hitter and integral families and for shaper and earliest transmit plus cake and time aware and transmission selection families. Count style entries use count sentinel minus one for highest index.

Payload contracts use fixed width integers with documented units and nesting. Classic delays use microseconds while slot and time aware fields use nanoseconds and rates use bytes or bits per second with 64 bit companions extending 32 bit fields. Likelihoods use fixed point where zero is none. Nested lists carry virtual queue objects and schedule entries plus class entries with padding preserving alignment. No variable length text appears.

Fixed width counters can wrap on long lived queues including byte and packet totals plus drop and mark tallies while single byte logarithmic fields quantize tuning coarsely. Fixed size priority and queue arrays require bounds checks against bitmask and queue limits and nested netlink lists require length validation. Signed timing and credit fields can go negative by design. These fragments show no locking or atomicity or validation behaviour.
